title: Keyword Research: Clearing the Confusion
subtitle: Copyright, keyword hats, pricing and a strong product

items.title: Grey hat
items.text: Copyright keywords: the account may be removed, or may not.

items.title: White hat
items.text: Not copyright, completely fine. Start here, grey hat only later.

columns.title: Old account
items: Listing removed 3 times, then the account goes

items.title: Orders, no volume?
items.text: The keyword may be in another language.

items.title: Physical or digital?
items.text: Search it on EHunt; products that talk shipping are physical.

items.title: Setting the price
items.text: Use the average of existing listings; leave a market spoiled by low prices.

sections.quote: Go from low competition to high volume.
sections.text: Organise keywords with Niche Deck (nichedeck.com); a keyword cannot be uploaded twice.

title: Finding Etsy Keywords in Bulk
subtitle: 70 to 80 of a listing's 100 SEO points come from keywords

items.title: Etsy suggestions
items.text: Focus keyword + space, then + a to z. Note every suggestion.

items.title: Ask any LLM
items.text: Low-KD, high-volume keywords for your niche, with KD, volume and trend.

items.title: Top 10 titles
items.text: Copy the top 10 listings' titles into AI with the expert prompt.

sections.text: The improved prompt forbids invented numbers: missing data is marked "Data unavailable".

sections.quote: Low competition, strong views, healthy engagement, stable demand, KD under 50.
sections.text: Never select on one strong metric alone; and one keyword is not enough, find related ones.
